charts.title: HATS-75 b: orbits around HATS-75
charts.description: The orbits of HATS-75's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HATS-75 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Jordán et al. 2022 (2022AJ....163..125J), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname JORD_AACUTE_N_ET_AL__2022): P 2.7886556 d

charts.title: HATS-75 b: its transit
charts.description: HATS-75 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (5, 31, 106) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 44737596, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 8-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 8-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
